common_base_g.cleanup_rule: body-4 third rule: dark-gray components inside the outer 12 px head ring, area <= 200 px.

construction.face_core_algorithm: Round 9 accepted face core retained byte-for-byte; each cheek-rest state uses the exact official R.png face partition, then copies only the eye and mouth rectangles from the corresponding pre-round9 product state. No face pixels are generated and no layer/compositor rule changes.
construction.frame_source_policy: For all 4 mouth families x 3 eye states, official R.png supplies the accepted face base; the eye box [420,320,820,470] and mouth box [420,470,760,640] are copied pixel-for-pixel from the matching .quality-tmp/official-cheek-9/product-before/bare state, restricted to the retained face-core mask.
construction.reason: 直接採用擁有者核准的固定影格，保留候選 PNG bytes，避免重編碼或重算造成位元差異。

owner_approval.scope: 六個托腮姿勢各 12 張嘴型與眼態，以及 6 個 face-core。
